FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
NOTICE
No. 42 /HJS Seniority CelU2026 Dated: 09 October,2026
Pursuant to order dated 11.03.2026 of the Hon'ble Supreme Court
passed in CivilAppeal No. 3947 of 2020 - Rejanish K.V. vs. K. Deepa &
Ors. And connected matters, for determination of inter se seniority of
Higher Judicial Service officers, objections/representations were invited
vide Notice No. 40/FIJS Seniority CelU2026 Dated: 22.08.2026, upto
t0.t0.2026.
In continuation of the above Notice, the last date for submission of
the objections/representations through eServices for Judicial Officers
portal, is hereby extended till 16.10.2026. Thereafter, no representation
shall be entertained.
(Pa )
Registrar (J)(Computer)
(I/c Selection & Appointment/Seniority)
